highlights.title: Create agent says when no model is connected
highlights.line: With no AI model connected, Create agent now says so where you can see it, with a link to connect one.

highlights.title: Start a new agent without imported files
highlights.line: When Claude Code asks whether a new agent may use files its instructions import from outside its folder, you can start it without them.

highlights.title: When messages get stuck behind an agent
highlights.line: If an idle Claude Code agent's input box stays full for about 40 minutes with messages waiting, its card says so and your phone can be told.

highlights.title: A question taken back stays on record
highlights.line: When an agent takes back a question and gives a reason, a line saying so stays in your chat with that agent.

highlights.title: Windows says when crash recovery is not set up
highlights.line: On Windows, when you turn on start at sign-in and Kosmos cannot set itself to reopen after a crash, Settings now says so.
